label: ercot32 v2rescore probe
definition: (PROBE — NOT a keeper swap; no LP solve) v2 emission-rate re-score of keeper ercot32-ordc-total-rtolcap under use_plant_emission_rates_v2=True. Dispatch/prices/generation are PROVABLY byte-identical (verified: emission_rate enters mc only via emission_rate×carbon_price; ERCOT has no state carbon program and backcast carbon_price=0, so the term is identically 0 — the committed runs.js carries a COMPACT CO2/fuelmix registration payload — the per-plant panels are omitted (data identical to the keeper's), and the full payload was verified byte-identical to the keeper before compaction). Only CO2 accounting moves. Re-scoring the keeper's persisted per-plant generation (plant_hourly_fit.model_gwh) through the v2 target-year rate map: COVERAGE 100/100/100% of model fossil GWh now carries a measured plant rate (the W A Parish mixed coal+gas exclusion is dissolved by the v2 unit-composition mask; the legacy TX-only artifact left it on a fuel-class default). v2-basis model CO2 159.7/156.3/159.6 Mt (2023/24/25); on the matched plant subset the v2 rate basis sits within −0.04/−0.50/+0.55% of the eGRID+CAMPD-v1 basis the dashboard C5a verdict uses — i.e. v2 reproduces the measured CO2 level, no distortion. The repo's own no-solve scorer (score_backcast_shape_emissions.py) corroborates: v2 CO2 9/9 PASS vs CAMPD-actual (160.9/158.3/160.2 model vs 155.9/155.6/157.7). Dashboard C5a verdict itself is UNCHANGED (it reads egrid.fossil_co2_rate_map, not plant_emission_rates_v2). Rules #1/#13/#15/#22: no retune, no keeper swap, holdouts 2022/H1-2026 untouched (v2 artifact has no such rows; only 2023-2025 read). §9.6 lane L-8b.
